description: This Java class 'LoanProductHelper' provides helper methods for managing loan products via API calls in the Fineract project. It includes methods to create, retrieve by external ID or ID, update by external ID or ID, and get a loan product template, utilizing the Fineract client utilities.

classes.name: LoanProductHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to perform CRUD operations and retrieve templates for loan products via Fineract API.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a new loan product with the provided request data.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a loan product details using its external ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a loan product details using its internal ID.

methods.name: updateLoanProductByExternalId
methods.description: Updates a loan product identified by its external ID with the provided request data.

methods.name: updateLoanProductById
methods.description: Updates a loan product identified by its internal ID with the provided request data.

methods.name: getLoanProductTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or configuring a loan product, optionally for product mix.
